summary: Software Engineer with 3 years on a customer-facing authentication platform at enterprise scale. I work at the protocol level across OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT/JWKS, SSO and federation, and on the security layer beneath — PKI, X.509 lifecycle, mTLS and TLS termination. Outside work I build applied AI/ML systems: agentic RAG, real-time computer vision and quantitative platforms.

experience.title: Software Engineer – Identity & Platform Engineering
description: Build and maintain Java/Spring Boot services on Telstra's customer identity (CIAM) platform — registration, authentication and authorization flows using OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT/JWKS validation, token introspection and exchange, session management, MFA and RBAC.

Part of the team that migrated 15+ enterprise applications from PCF to OpenShift with zero authentication downtime — rebuilding auth integration, secure routing and IP allow-listing ahead of each cutover.
Worked on end-to-end mTLS with automated X.509 issuance and rotation, removing manual certificate renewal as a recurring outage risk, and on TLS termination at the CDN edge.

Worked on the edge migration from legacy WAF to AWS CloudFront + WAFv2 — OWASP-aligned rule groups, regex pattern sets, IP reputation lists and rate-based rules — with a phased, zero-downtime DNS cutover across 10+ downstream apps.
Configured OIDC/OAuth 2.0 clients in PingFederate and SecureAuth for SSO and single logout across enterprise apps, including federation with Salesforce and Entra ID.
Contributed to platform modernization — Java/Spring Boot upgrades, dependency and vulnerability remediation, and CI/CD automation.

cloud: AWS (CloudFront, Route 53, S3, IAM, Lambda, CloudWatch)
